description: See every Claude Code session at a glance — working, waiting or idle — and exactly which files each one changed. Read-only.
config.lookbackHours: How many hours of changes to show. Running sessions are always listed.
config.showShellGuesses: Also show files guessed from shell commands (>, >>, tee, sed -i, cp, mv …), marked with a yellow S.
config.hideScratchpadFiles: Hide Claude's throwaway scratchpad files under /tmp/claude-*. Git worktrees inside the scratchpad stay visible.
config.includeSubagents: Show files changed by subagents under their parent session.
config.pollSeconds: How often (seconds) to check for new log lines while the view is visible. Only newly appended lines are read.
